title: Neuraxis: perturbation-battery testing for behavioural preservation in computational neuron models (Study 1 code, configuration and results)
description: Software, frozen configuration, preregistration record and sealed results for a preregistered held-out evaluation of whether canonical regression tests detect behaviour-changing faults in NeuroML neuron models (AsPredicted #312455). Includes the analysis pipeline, the sealed confirmatory campaign heldout-v1, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure in the manuscript.
